history.name: CSVHandling_Expert
history.content:
The structure is consistent: each book has 5 lines (Title, Author, Publisher, Genre, Status), with headers and category labels interleaved.
I will parse the text, remove headers/category labels, group into 5-line records, then filter for Rick Riordan and count Status in {Checked Out, Overdue}.

Code:
```python
import pandas as pd
from functions import extract_pdf_text

pdf_path = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/e9a2c537-8232-4c3f-85b0-b52de6bcba99.pdf"
text = extract_pdf_text(pdf_path)

lines = [ln.strip() for ln in text.splitlines() if ln.strip()]
noise = {
    "Scribe County Public Library","Title","Author","Publisher","Genre","Status","Books",
    "Young Children's","Middle Grade","Young Adult"
}
clean = [ln for ln in lines if ln not in noise]

# group every 5 lines into a record
records = [clean[i:i+5] for i in range(0, len(clean), 5)]
# keep only well-formed records
records = [r for r in records if len(r) == 5]

df = pd.DataFrame(records, columns=["Title","Author","Publisher","Genre","Status"])\
       .replace({"Author": {"Riordan, Rick": "Rick Riordan"}})

riordan = df[df["Author"].str.lower().str.contains("rick riordan")].copy()
riordan["Status_lower"] = riordan["Status"].str.lower()
not_on = riordan[riordan["Status_lower"].isin(["checked out","overdue"])]

print("Total Rick Riordan books:", len(riordan))
print("Number not on shelves:", len(not_on))
print(not_on[["Title","Status"]])
```
